notes.title: [Major update] chapter 2 available in the free demo! (until 6/17)
notes.notes:
[h1]Check out the second chapter of 'Reverie' in the free demo![/h1]

Hi! Min & Insu here. I'm happy to announce that there has been a major update to [b]Reverie[/b].
Take a peek at all the changes by playing the demo!


[b]The new demo includes: [/b]

- Story chapter 2 (Available until 6/17)

- 6 extra levels

- Completely reworked graphics & music

- Quality-of-life changes such as key rebinding, options for game speed change, etc.

- Story cutscenes


Thanks for reading, and have fun playing the demo!
All kinds of feedback are welcome in the steam community.
